title: Actual open extension unit is invertible after exact localization
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, A a subterminal sheaf of sets, and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Use the actual extension/restriction adjunction and exact functors of [def-pur-topos-open-scalar-section-data]. Then the unit of its exact-derived adjunction is an isomorphism. No represented-open or enough-points assumption is used.

source.place: Tags 04IE and 0E8I; subterminal specialization of the sectionwise direct-sum formula.

proof.text: Yoneda and sheafification identify sections of A at U with arrows from the sheafified representable to A. Subterminality makes this Hom set a subsingleton. Each element-site object supplies one section, so the restricted direct-sum extension has exactly one summand and its inclusion is an isomorphism. The displayed direct-sum Hom adjunction is the actual unit.

The element projection is continuous and cocontinuous, so restriction commutes with sheafification. The sheafified extension/restriction composite is therefore isomorphic to the identity. Adjoint uniqueness (or the monad unit-isomorphism criterion) makes its actual unit invertible.

The degreewise adjunction unit is invertible in every degree. The localization unit formula identifies the exact-derived unit on a quotient object with the quotient of this cochain unit composed with factorization isomorphisms. This is invertible. Every derived object is isomorphic to a quotient object, hence the natural transformation is invertible.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04IE and 0E8I; explicit single-summand unit proof and exact localization.
